name: TurnManager
src_typeComment: Singleton battle director: register combatants (TurnBasedActor self-registers), call StartBattle(), and this runs the whole turn loop — rebuilding initiative order each round, auto-resolving AI turns via UtilityAIBrain, and pausing for player-controlled actors until your UI calls SubmitPlayerAction(). No custom state code needed — the turn flow itself is the one thing this toolkit uses StateMachine's spirit for at the battle level (Idle/ActorTurnAI/WaitingForPlayerInput/BattleOver) without literally needing the StateMachine class, since the flow is simple enough as a plain state enum + a few methods.

src_serialized.name: aiThinkDelay
src_serialized.tooltip: Seconds an AI turn pauses before executing, so its action doesn't happen instantly/invisibly.
